ideas.title: Crash Trucks for Gold 🚚
ideas.hook: Drive a heavy truck full speed into walls of rock and ore. The harder you crash, the more ore breaks loose and falls into your truck bed.
core_loop: Pick a truck and a mine tunnel
Build up speed down the ramp
Smash into ore walls and keep the truck alive
Haul the loose ore back before the truck falls apart
Sell ore and upgrade the bumper, engine and frame
ideas.twist: Your truck takes real crash damage. Every hit breaks more ore, but if you lose a wheel you have to limp home with whatever stayed in the bed.
monetization: VIP garage with a bonus truck slot
retention: Deeper tunnels with rarer ore unlocked by depth
Weekly mine event with a limited ore
Codes for repair kits on updates
Server leaderboard for the biggest single crash
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig + Race / drive is a top pair (9 new games, 136,366 new-game CCU). Break / mine / dig is at 1.71 (up 0.23 this week), Physics Sim is the top subgenre at 2.65, and realistic art is at 1.96. Crash Engine (42,364 CCU) and BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (29,750) show crash physics pulls players.
ideas.differentiator: Crashing is how you mine, not just a show, so how you hit the wall decides what you earn.

ideas.title: Tunnel for Flags 🚩
ideas.hook: Two armies dig tunnels under a blocky battlefield to reach the enemy flag from below, while defenders dig counter-tunnels to cut them off.
core_loop: Join a team and grab a shovel or drill
Dig toward the enemy base under the surface
Fight enemy diggers when your tunnels meet
Pop up under their flag and run it home
Spend war points on better drills and gear
ideas.twist: The ground is shared. Every tunnel you dig is also a path the enemy can use, and tunnels can collapse onto whoever is inside.
monetization: VIP pass with a faster drill
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig + Fight / battle is a top pair (9 new games, 154,102 CCU). Military / war is at 1.69 with Voxel Wars (29,969 CCU), Break / mine / dig is at 1.71, and Voxel / blocky is the fastest rising art style at 2.34.
ideas.differentiator: The fight happens underground, so map control is about where you dig, not where you stand.

ideas.title: Grow Aliens for Cash 👽
ideas.hook: Plant alien seeds in craters on your own moon plot. They hatch into little aliens that make cash, and the low gravity means a careless harvest floats away.
core_loop: Plant alien seeds in craters
Water them with space goo until they hatch
Collect cash from grown aliens
Sell or keep them to fill the alien index
Buy rarer seeds and bigger craters
ideas.twist: Meteor showers hit random plots. A hit can mutate an alien into a rare glowing form or knock it into space.
monetization: Storage pass for more alien slots
retention: Alien index with rewards per page
ideas.why_now: Space is at 2.37 and Grow / farm is at 1.82 with Throw a Seed (44,598 CCU) and [🐜] Ant Evolution (19,077). Collect / index + Grow / farm is a pair (6 new games, 51,141 CCU) and Money / rich is at 1.89.
ideas.differentiator: Space weather is both the risk and the luck source, so you decide when to protect your plot and when to gamble.

ideas.title: Fish a Flooded Town 🌊
ideas.hook: A town has flooded. Paddle a boat through the streets and cast into windows, shops and car parks to reel up cars, safes, pets and furniture.
core_loop: Paddle to a street in the flood
Cast into buildings and reel up items
Bring catches back to your rooftop base
Sell them or keep them for the flood index
Upgrade your rod, boat and line strength
ideas.twist: The water level changes every few minutes. Low water opens ground-floor shops, high water opens rooftops and the rarest catches.
retention: Flood index with rewards per street
Limited storm event with a new catch set
ideas.why_now: Disaster / weather is the top theme at 2.41 with Stop The Tsunami! (16,555 CCU). Fishing is at 1.46 and up 0.54 this week with [🐟] Fish For Sea Animals (37,698) and Cast For Fish! (21,095). Collect / index + Fishing is a pair with 16 new games and 128,080 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: You fish a whole town instead of open water, so every building is a different loot pool.

ideas.title: Grow Ghosts at Night 👻
ideas.hook: Your graveyard plot only grows ghost crops after dark, but the night also brings monsters that try to eat your harvest.
core_loop: Plant ghost seeds at dusk
Defend the plot with a lantern and tools at night
Harvest ghost crops at sunrise
Sell them and buy stronger seeds and defenses
Push into longer, scarier nights
ideas.twist: The rarest ghosts only grow in the dark corners where monsters spawn, so greed means danger.
monetization: VIP plot with an extra row
ideas.why_now: Horror is up 0.54 this week to 1.28 with Suzy Says! [HORROR] (18,648 CCU) and [🏴‍☠️] Throw a Friend for Monsters (20,424). Grow / farm is at 1.82, and the night-survive format is working for Stay the Night (19,828).
ideas.differentiator: Farming and survival share one clock: day is safe but nothing grows, night pays but bites.

ideas.title: +1 Kaiju Size 🦖
ideas.hook: You are a tiny kaiju that gets +1 size every second. Stomp through blocky cities and break bigger buildings as you grow.
core_loop: Grow +1 size every second
Stomp buildings for cash
Buy size boosters
Unlock bigger city zones
Rebirth for a permanent size multiplier
ideas.twist: Each zone has a size gate: too small and you cannot break the towers, too big and you crush the bonus coins too.
monetization: Pet storage pass for baby kaiju
ideas.why_now: +1 ___ is a rising title formula at 1.46 with [🧬] +1 Venom Evolution (12,392 CCU). Giant / huge is at 1.70 with Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll | [MAJOR UPDATE] (14,185), and Break / mine / dig is at 1.71.
ideas.differentiator: Growth is felt through destruction, so the +1 number turns into bigger buildings falling.

ideas.title: Fish Up Outfits 👗
ideas.hook: Cast into a sparkly lake and reel up clothes instead of fish. Wear your rarest catches and show them off on the dock.
core_loop: Cast and reel up clothing pieces
Wear them right away
Sell duplicates for coins
Fill the outfit index by set
Unlock new lakes with rarer sets
ideas.twist: Pieces come in matching sets. Wearing a full set gives a luck bonus for the next set.
ideas.why_now: Fishing + Fashion / beauty is an open gap (score 2.75). Fishing is up 0.54 this week to 1.46 with Fish for Secret Animals! (24,445 CCU) and [EVENT] River Hunter (23,652), and Collect / index is up 0.28 to 1.24.
ideas.differentiator: Every catch is something you wear, so the index is also your avatar.

ideas.title: Bat Stars for Pets ⭐
ideas.hook: Falling stars drop from the sky. Hit them with your bat and the farther they fly, the rarer the star pet that lands.
core_loop: Wait for a falling star
Time your swing to bat it
Collect the star pet where it lands
Equip pets for swing power
Unlock new sky zones
ideas.twist: Each zone's sky has planets in the way. Bounce a star off a planet for a mutation bonus.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top rising mechanic at 1.99 (up 0.44) with Throw a Seed (44,598 CCU) and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (110,080). Space is at 2.37, and Collect / index + Hit / swing / launch is a pair with 129,948 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: You hit a moving target from the sky instead of throwing from a stand, so timing matters as much as power.

ideas.title: Shoot Shadows to Survive 🔦
ideas.hook: Shadow monsters hunt you through a dark building. Your only weapon is a light gun, and it runs out of battery.
core_loop: Enter the building with a crew
Shoot shadows with light beams
Find batteries and fuses
Turn the lights back on room by room
Escape and spend coins on better guns
ideas.twist: Lit rooms are safe but drain shared power, so the team has to choose which rooms to keep lit.
ideas.why_now: Horror is up 0.54 this week to 1.28, Interiors / corridors is the top rising map style at 1.77, and Shooter is at 1.38. Fight / battle + Survive is a pair (10 new games, 63,953 CCU), with Stay the Night (19,828) and NIGHT WITH OPAH (27,936) showing night-horror pull.
ideas.differentiator: Light is ammo, safety and the score at once, so every shot costs something.

ideas.title: Build a Battle Blimp 🎈
ideas.hook: Build your own blimp from balloons, armor and cannons, then fly it into sky battles against other players' builds.
core_loop: Build a blimp from unlocked parts
Fly into a sky arena
Shoot down rival blimps
Earn parts and coins
Build bigger blimps
ideas.twist: Every balloon you lose drops your blimp lower, so damage changes how you fly.
ideas.why_now: Build a ___ is a rising title formula at 1.23 with Build Your World! 🔨 (30,218 CCU). Paint / create is at 1.59, Sandbox is at 1.86, and Military / war is at 1.69 with Voxel Wars (29,969). Fight / battle + Shooter is a pair with 160,833 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Your build is your health bar, so design choices show up in every fight.
